successCriteria.description: The `LeaveRequest` interface is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` with all canonical fields: `id: string`, `employeeId: string`, `leavePolicyId: string`, `startDate: Date`, `endDate: Date`, `reason: string | undefined`, `status: LeaveRequestStatus`, `approvedBy: string | null`, `approvedAt: Date | null`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`. It imports `LeaveRequestStatus` from `src/shared/types/leave-request-status.enum.ts`.

The `ILeaveRepository` interface is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts` with all seven methods: `findById`, `findByEmployee`, `findByEmployeeAndStatus`, `findOverlapping`, `create`, `update`, `findPendingByEmployee` — each with the exact signatures specified in the phase scope.

`LeaveRepository` class implements `ILeaveRepository` using the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, with a constructor accepting an optional `Pool | PoolClient` (defaulting to the shared pool) — matching the existing pattern in `EmployeeRepository`, `PolicyRepository`, and `BalanceRepository`.

`LeaveRepository.create` inserts a row into the `leave_requests` table with all provided fields (excluding `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` which are generated server-side) and returns the created `LeaveRequest` with the generated `id` and timestamps.

`LeaveRepository.findOverlapping` returns only `LeaveRequest` rows where `employee_id` matches, `status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED')`, and the date range overlaps (`start_date <= $endDate AND end_date >= $startDate`), optionally excluding a given `excludeId`.
`LeaveRepository.findPendingByEmployee` returns all `LeaveRequest` rows for the given `employeeId` where `status = 'SUBMITTED'`.

`LeaveRepository.update` uses a dynamic field-map loop (matching the pattern in `EmployeeRepository.update` and `PolicyRepository.update`) to build a parameterized `UPDATE` statement, sets `updated_at` to the current timestamp, and returns the updated `LeaveRequest` or `null` if not found.

A private `rowToLeaveRequest` helper maps `snake_case` DB columns to `camelCase` TypeScript properties with correct type conversions: `id` as string, `employee_id` as string, `leave_policy_id` as string, `start_date`/`end_date`/`created_at`/`updated_at` as `new Date()`, `approved_at` as `Date | null` (conditional), `approved_by` as `string | null`, `reason` as `string | undefined`, `status` as `LeaveRequestStatus`.
`src/modules/leave/index.ts` barrel-exports `LeaveRequest`, `ILeaveRepository`, and `LeaveRepository`.

Jest unit tests exist in `tests/unit/modules/leave/` covering: each query method (found and not-found cases), `create` (verifying SQL and params), `update` (found, not-found, no-fields-to-update), `findOverlapping` (with and without `excludeId`), `findPendingByEmployee`, and constructor-with-custom-client — following the test conventions established in `employee.repository.test.ts`, `policy.repository.test.ts`, and `balance.repository.test.ts`.

The `LeaveRepository` constructor must accept an optional `Pool | PoolClient` parameter defaulting to the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, matching the transaction contract in `.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json`.
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
The `LeaveRequest` model must import `LeaveRequestStatus` from `src/shared/types/leave-request-status.enum.ts` — not redefine it and not import from a different path.

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED; any non-terminal status → CANCELLED. The `status` field must always be one of the five `LeaveRequestStatus` values. The repository does not enforce transitions (that is the service's responsibility), but it must store and retrieve the status faithfully.

`approvedBy` and `approvedAt` are both `null` when the request has not been acted upon (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, CANCELLED). When status transitions to APPROVED or REJECTED, both fields must be set together — but this invariant is enforced by the service layer, not the repository.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer — repositories are data-access only. Auth is enforced at the controller/route layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns empty array (not null, not error) when no overlapping requests exist.
Returns `null` when no row matches the given `id` — never throws.

Generates `id` (via DB default), sets `createdAt` and `updatedAt` to the current timestamp. Returns the fully-hydrated `LeaveRequest`. Fails with a DB error if FK constraints are violated (e.g., invalid `employeeId` or `leavePolicyId`).
Returns `null` when the target row does not exist. Returns the existing row unchanged when the `data` argument is empty (no-op). Always bumps `updated_at` when fields are changed.
